forum.title: STM32 Cube AI studio E200(ValidationError): E801(HwIOError): Invalid firmware
forum.best_answer_content: NVM, resolved with updating other tools used by ST edge AI studio
forum.content_text:
Hello, I'm trying to create a project with custom model via STM32 Cube AI studio, which uses STedge Core AI v. 3.0.0. Validation is performed on STM32N6570-DK.

I'm getting following error:

```

E200(ValidationError): TARGET: Unable to bind the ST.AI runtime with "network" c-model: []

E801(HwIOError): Invalid firmware - COM7:115200

```

When running same command from command line I see that progress goes to 74,8 % and then stucks until error is displayed.

See attached failed report for details.
forum.author: serg22

scraped_replies.html: NVM, resolved with updating other tools used by ST edge AI studio
scraped_replies.author: serg22

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @serg22,

 

Thanks for the update.

Indeed, most of the issue we see are due to other tools version.

For future readers, please update all the required tools.

 

We are aware that it is a bit annoying and we are looking on how to improve the experience.

 

Have a good day,

Julian
